body_markdown:
Our Chief Financial Officer, Amanda Coussens, recently joined FINTECH.TV at NYSE Texas to discuss the evolution of Ridgepost Capital as a Dallas-based public company.


In the interview, Amanda discusses Ridgepost Capital’s organic and inorganic growth strategy, the ways technology and AI are shaping the future of our platform, and where we see opportunities for growth across the private markets.
